title: Reconcile AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md guidance divergence
description: bd preflight --check reports that AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md user-authored content diverge even though AGENTS.md is intended as the shared source of operational guidance. Investigate the divergence, decide whether CLAUDE.md should import/symlink AGENTS.md or intentionally opt out, and update the files or bd configuration accordingly. This is unrelated to loreweaver-0jq.21 package metadata work.
acceptance_criteria: bd preflight --check no longer reports AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md divergence, or the divergence is explicitly documented with the bd-doctor opt-out comment if intentional.
close_reason: Added the explicit bd-doctor divergence opt-out to CLAUDE.md because its short AGENTS.md import stub is intentional; verification: bd preflight --check now reports AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md in sync, and npm run check:hidden-unicode passed.
